_comment: Owner gate (2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): the endpoints marked _owner_gate read licence-derived data and answer the owner's account alone, so they are marked auth and this spec runs with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session. A --auth-signup user is not an owner and gets 403 owner_only; the refusals are asserted in public-surface.json (signed out) and auth-gated.json (signed in, not the owner).

endpoints._note: SEC-1 (2026-10-26): the structure path is a signed-in read; run with --auth-signup.
endpoints._owner_gate: Owner gate (2026-10-26): owner only, since this read carries data computed from the licensed options feed. Run with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session; signed out is 403 auth_required (public-surface.json) and a signed-up non-owner is 403 owner_only (auth-gated.json).
